wins: Identified network perimeter services quickly using initial scans, allowing situational awareness within first 3 steps
Captured consistent data on open web and SSH services that can inform follow-up reconnaissance tactics
fails: Failed to exploit any discovered service within the single episode, yielding 0% success rate despite decent reward
Exceeded mentor interaction budget early, indicating inefficient decision sequencing and lack of decisive next actions
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was efficiently executed, but lack of follow-through on exploitation and frequent mentor reliance prevented closure; needs sharper prioritization and concrete exploitation steps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attempted exploitation without validated credentials or usable payload delivery, causing repeated aborts

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 443 opened by web service during reconnaissance
skill_cards.then_action: Run Nikto scan followed by DirBuster to enumerate web directories

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH banner indicates outdated service and port 22 is open
skill_cards.then_action: Execute nmap version and sshv1 scripts followed by attempt credential-based login

skill_cards.if_condition: When system fingerprinting yields Linux distribution with known CVE
skill_cards.then_action: Match exploit-db entries and stage Metasploit auxiliary module validation before execution

memory_ops.reason: Consistent early reconnaissance success using web enumeration established repeatable data collection path

next_experiments.title: Focused web exploitation
next_experiments.description: After strong enumeration of web service, pivot to validation of directory traversal or SQLi from collected endpoints and automate payload trials

next_experiments.title: Credential validation automation
next_experiments.description: Integrate SSH/SMB credential spray sequences immediately after banner analysis to reduce idle steps waiting for mentor input

next_experiments.title: Exploit decision gating
next_experiments.description: Implement checkpoint that requires proof-of-concept viability (e.g., shell upload or response) before proceeding to exploitation phase to avoid repeated aborts
